title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard guard drops late Ok but still applies a late Error to the wrong vacancy's board (B2 residual)
evidence:
case result, model.leaderboard_vacancy_id {
        Ok(response), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id -> #(
          ...
        Error(err), _ -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Failure(error_page_copy(
              err,
              copy.CtxApplicationsLoadList,
            )),
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
        _, _ -> #(model, effect.none())
detail: The new vacancy-id guard matches only the Ok arm. A late Error from vacancy A (fetch in flight, landlord navigates to B, A's request fails) still lands and replaces B's board with a Failure error page. The page variant likewise clears leaderboard_loading_more unconditionally.
recommended_fix: Guard the Error arm too: only apply Failure when leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(vacancy_id); otherwise return #(model, effect.none()). Same for ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage's Error arm.

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding still untested (still present since round 2)
detail: The r3 diff adds the pb-28 branch to vacancy_detail but the only pb-28 tests (client_test.gleam:5200-5221) render application_detail_page.view. No test renders pages/vacancy_detail with comparison_ids set, so the vacancy-side regression the r2 warning named is still unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail test mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test: render with comparison_ids [] and ["e1","e2"], assert pb-28 absent/present.

title: Filter pill shrink-0 change still has no test (still present since round 2)
detail: The only shrink-0 assertion in the client suite is status_stepper_stops_do_not_squash_test (client_test.gleam:5191). The existing view_leaderboard tests (4105-4188) never assert shrink-0, so the filter-pill fix from the mobile sweep remains unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extend one of the existing leaderboard_view.view_leaderboard render tests to assert the rendered html contains "shrink-0" on the filter pills.

title: Rejected/auto-closed stepper rails still lack md:justify-end that the pipeline rail gained (still present since round 2)
evidence: "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible",
detail: The r3 diff re-bases the rejected (321) and auto-closed (381) rails on the same flex/scroll classes but still omits md:justify-end, which the pipeline rail (210) has; desktop alignment of these two rails still differs from the pipeline rail.
recommended_fix: Append md:justify-end to the rail class strings in view_rejected and view_auto_closed to match view_pipeline.

title: demo_flow_test binds notifications then discards with let _ (still present since round 2, repeated in the new deep-link test)
evidence:
let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store)
  unread |> should.equal(1)
  after.show_notification_dropdown |> should.be_false
  let _ = notifications
detail: The new demo_application_notification_deep_links_to_maples_test repeats the pattern the r2 note flagged: notifications is bound only to be discarded. Assert on the bound value or destructure with let #(_, unread).
recommended_fix: Replace with let #(_, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store) and drop the let _ line.

title: leaderboard_vacancy_id set-sites (fetch/refresh/navigation transitions) still not directly pinned
evidence:
vacancy_detail_request_id: Some(id),
        leaderboard: Loading,
        leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id),
detail: The r3 tests pin the handler-side guard (drop late Ok, apply matching), but no test drives UserClickedLeaderboard / browser-change and asserts leaderboard_vacancy_id is stamped Some(id); a future diff dropping a set-site would only be caught indirectly.
recommended_fix: Add a small test calling client.update with the vacancy-detail navigation message and assert the returned model's leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(id).

title: vacancy_detail renders an empty class attribute when no comparison is active (still present since round 2)
detail: With no active comparison the div renders class="". Harmless but noisy; application_detail avoided it by folding the padding into a single class string.
recommended_fix: Use class names that omit the attribute in the empty case, e.g. build the attribute list conditionally or default to a meaningful base class.
